Cashback and loyalty in Telegram

Customers show a QR code at the till and earn cashback, and you see who comes back and whom to send an offer. An MVP in 3–5 weeks, from UZS 30 mln; the full version in 7–12 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Sign-up with phone number
  • QR card in the bot
  • Cashback or points added by the cashier scanning the QR in the bot (POS link is in the full version)
  • Balance and history
  • Broadcast messages
What the full version adds
  • POS integration (iiko, R-Keeper or 1C)
  • Levels and birthday offers
  • Referral bonuses
  • Segments by visit frequency
  • Campaign results report
  • Mini App card

What we need from you

  • A company Telegram account for the bot
  • The list of products or services with prices
  • A person who takes the orders

Questions

What does “Cashback and loyalty in Telegram” cost?
The MVP costs $2,500–5,000 (UZS 30–61 mln), the full version $7,000–16,000 (UZS 84–193 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Cashback and loyalty in Telegram” take?
The MVP takes 3–5 weeks, the full version 7–12 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
A company Telegram account for the bot; The list of products or services with prices; A person who takes the orders.
